}}During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was concerned about the [[Kuati anarchist group|anarchist]] movement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. He sent his trusted [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on a '''mission'''.

==History==
A [[23 BBY/Legends|year]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] hired [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] [[Larbo]], the leader of a [[Kuati anarchist group|resistance]] force fighting to liberate [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] [[Kuati/Legends|population]] from servitude. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]] accompanied his father to [[Kuat City]], where Jango used the young boy as bait to lure their target into the open.<ref name="Tales18" />

While Jango systematically eliminated anarchists, Boba threw a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and fled into the [[Tent/Legends|tents]]. Larbo eventually cornered the boy, only to realize with horror that the child was the son of the legendary [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] sent to kill him.<ref name="Tales18" />

Having cleared the rest of the camp, Jango tracked them down and slashed through the tent's canopy. He demanded his son's release, offering Larbo a final chance to surrender. When the stubborn anarchist leader refused, Jango executed him on the spot. Visibly shaken by the brutality, Boba escaped with his father aboard ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'', where they contacted the Count to report their successful mission.<ref name="Tales18" />
